decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed, which contained a high percentage of camping accessories (towels, chairs, pads, and morale patches) rather than traditional backpacks. For my consideration set, I selected the five most distinct backpack types: an EDC/concealed carry pack (prod_backpacks_038), an ultralight hiking pack (prod_backpacks_041), a packable daypack (prod_backpacks_156), a tactical sling bag (prod_backpacks_167), and a wheeled travel backpack (prod_backpacks_047). I ultimately chose the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic (prod_backpacks_038) because it had the highest quality rating (4.7) and reviews that emphasized extreme durability and comfort. The Granite Gear hiking pack (prod_backpacks_041), while a reputable brand, had concerning reviews about strap failure during initial use, making the Maxpedition the most reliable purchase.
